facts.fact: Le Soir d'Algerie reports that Algeria's ANPDP announced on 11 November 2026 its Deliberation No. 05 on personal data in CVs, taken under Law 18-07.
Le Soir d'Algerie reports the ANPDP applying Law 18-07 of 10 June 2018, as amended, through Deliberation No. 05 of 11 November 2026.
Le Soir d'Algerie reports Deliberation No. 05, taken under Law 18-07, binding public and private recipients of CVs to delete unneeded data and keep CVs one year.
Deliberation No. 05 is a general rule on CV data, not a decision on one controller, per Le Soir d'Algerie.
